task: MELD next-turn official sentiment (3-class) with continuous low-dimensional source-turn features
row_alignment: features are from source turn t; Y and same-speaker relation refer to next turn t+1
feature_precision: float32 transformed values serialized with 8 significant decimal digits
fit_policy: TF-IDF/SVD/PCA/scalers fitted on train only without train/test outcome labels; test transformed once
c_definition: source speaker is one of six major characters x next turn same speaker
content_boundary: The table contains public MELD indices and low-dimensional transformed features; transcripts, media, and pre-reduction feature arrays are not included.
